title: Plakar Minecraft Server Importer Connector Config

location.description: minecraft://<server directory>, the one holding server.properties and the worlds

quiesce.description: Pause world saves over RCON while the backup runs; refuses to back up a running server that cannot be paused

rcon.description: host:port of the RCON console, read from server.properties when omitted

timeout.description: Time allowed for each RCON exchange, such as 5m

dont_traverse_fs.description: Do not follow mount points under the server directory
